== Summary ==
Slip “•Supremacy: Throne Room” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 1355, 1102, 2077)). Version [[Supremacy: Throne Room]] (Original). Not a recreation.
